name: GeoExplorer
description: A real map with country borders: plot locations as bubbles by latitude and longitude, or fill countries by name, with a ranked list.
lede: Plot points by latitude and longitude, or colour whole countries by name. Real borders, zoom and pan, and no map service needed.

roles.name: location
roles.help: A country name for a filled map (for example Uganda or Kenya), or the label for each point.

roles.name: latitude
roles.help: Latitude in decimal degrees. Use together with Longitude.

roles.name: longitude
roles.help: Longitude in decimal degrees. Use together with Latitude.

roles.name: value
roles.help: Measure that sets bubble size, or the depth of colour for a country.

steps: For a filled map: add a Location with country names, and a Size / colour measure.
For points: add Latitude and Longitude (and a Location for labels).
Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, click a country or bubble to cross-filter.
Names that are not recognised are listed under the map so you can correct them.

faq.q: Does it need an internet connection or a map service?
faq.a: No. The country borders are bundled inside the visual, so it works in secure environments.

faq.q: Which names does the filled map recognise?
faq.a: English country names, plus common alternatives such as USA, UK, DRC and Ivory Coast. Unrecognised names are listed under the map.

faq.q: Can it draw regions or districts inside a country?
faq.a: Not yet. Use Latitude and Longitude for points at that level.
